MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The sealed splice connectors and assorted heat shrink tubing complement my earlier crimp connector kit by helping join and insulate wires during repairs.",
    "The small J-B Weld pack feels useful alongside my tape and vinyl cement because it offers another practical repair option without requiring a large specialized supply."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The large woodworking glue refill and ten-pack of super glue go beyond what my adhesive purchases show I need; the material, application, and quantity matter to me.",
    "The caliper and locking nuts could be useful for some repairs, but I have no specific measurement or fastening task that would make me choose them now.",
    "The other tubing kits and hundred-pack of Wago connectors overlap with the wiring supplies I would already choose on this visit, so their relevance does not mean I need them all."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying Gorilla tape seems to have been taken as interest in other Gorilla adhesives, even though glue serves a different purpose.",
    "My clamp and connector purchases seem to have been stretched into a broad need for workshop tools and hardware, without a clear connection to a current task."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The useful connection is how a new supply complements something I already own, such as tubing that insulates connections made with my connector kit.",
    "Package size and intended application affect my choices: a small repair epoxy pack feels more appropriate now than a large specialty adhesive refill.",
    "I would choose one suitable heat shrink assortment this time; several related products can fit my interests while still being unnecessary together."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my practical repair interests, but sometimes mistake related supplies, shared brands, and general workshop usefulness for a current need."
}
